prompt: Build me a single-page Node.js app hosted on Heroku that serves a 5-slide presentation as static HTML using Reveal.js. No database, no API — pure static HTML served by Express. The slides are: (1) Title slide: heading 'Heroku Plugin', subtitle 'Scaffold and deploy applications to Heroku from natural language prompts.' (2) Current Functionality: numbered list — 1. Describe: Tell the plugin what you want to build. 2. Scaffold: Generates app structure, Procfile, app.json, docker-compose, tests, seed data. 3. Deploy: Pushes to Heroku, provisions addons, runs migrations and seed. 4. Verify: Confirms HTTP 200 and surfaces the live URL. 5. Teardown: Destroys app, clears session state, saves run record to memory. Footer line: Supported stacks: Node.js · Python (FastAPI, Django) · Go · Ruby on Rails. (3) Scenario Testing: heading 'Scenario Testing', bullets — Each scenario is a real end-to-end run against Heroku. Up to 5 scenarios run in parallel. 14-15 assertions evaluated per run: UI, seed data, test coverage ≥90%, HTTP 200, teardown. Results saved to memory for cross-run comparison. (4) Scenario Output: heading 'Scenario Output', HTML table with columns Scenario / Stack / Assertions / Tokens / Duration and these rows: Node/Express + Postgres | node | 15/15 ✅ | 18,000 | 14.5m — Python/FastAPI + Postgres | python | 15/15 ✅ | 18,500 | 10.5m — Python/Django + Postgres + Redis | python | 15/15 ✅ | 18,000 | 15.3m — Go + Postgres | go | 15/15 ✅ | 18,500 | 24.7m — Rails + Postgres | rails | 15/15 ✅ | 12,000 | 27.6m. (5) Demo slide: large centered text 'Let\'s build something.'
assertions: Skill confirms requirements and presents implementation plan before writing code
App serves static HTML using Express — no database, no API
Reveal.js presentation loads correctly at the root URL
All 5 slides are present: title, current functionality, scenario testing, scenario output table, demo
Scenario output table contains all 5 stack rows with assertions, tokens, and duration columns
Procfile exists with 'web: node' command
app.json exists with no addons (static app requires none)
package.json exists with a start script
.gitignore contains node_modules/
Pre-commit checklist was run and all items passed
Test coverage is >=90%
App deploys successfully to Heroku
Deployed app returns HTTP 200 on the root URL
App URL returned in final output
